description: R08 Host History duplicate-policy checkpoint: safe Rust owns Microsoft's sequential/nonsequential command-add duplicate semantics, completing HistoryTests.cpp with no remaining Missing contracts.

entries.notes: Sequential identical commands are always suppressed even when suppressDuplicates is false.
Sequential identical commands remain a single entry when suppressDuplicates is true.
With suppressDuplicates=false, a nonadjacent duplicate is retained as a new command, yielding dir/cd/dir.
With suppressDuplicates=true, an earlier exact duplicate is removed and promoted to the newest slot, yielding cd/dir.
